annotations.title: Call a method in the running game

description:
Call one method on a node in the RUNNING game and return its result, to trigger gameplay code directly. A call is an action, not proof: check what it did with summer_game_probe.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/runtime-call"}

args.description: Positional arguments. JSON scalars, arrays and objects pass as-is; math values as Godot literal strings ('Vector3(0, 1, 0)'). Object and RID arguments are refused (bad_args).

instance.description: Game instance to address (default 'main' = the editor's embedded game).

method.description: Method name to call on the node, e.g. 'take_damage', 'get_velocity'.

name: summer_runtime_call
title: Call a method in the running game
